content: Yakobus dipatei – Petrus dirappanan illalan mai tarungkun
Attu iatoo naparandukmi ungkarra'i pira-pira to mangngorean tomaraya Herodes.
Susinna umpopepatei Yakobus sirondongna Yohanes dibatta pa'dang.
Tappana naissanan tomaraya Herodes kumua dore' to Yahudi ummitai pa'palakona, ussua pole omi tau umpealai Petrus. Attu iatoo allo kamai disanga Roti Tae' Diboloi Ragi.
Dialai Petrus, ditarungkummi nadagai pole sapulo annan tantara sibala'-bala' sanda siappa'. Annu la diparessa dio tingngayona tau kamban ke lessu'mi Allo Paskah.
Ditarungkummi Petrus, sapo' tontong liu napa'sambayangan to mangngorean langngan Puang Allata'alla.

La naparessami Herodes dio tingngyona tau kamban Petrus dikua makale'. Bongii, mamma'mi Petrus napaillan alla' dua tantara dipungo rante bassi patomali limanna. Dengampi tantara daga dio sa'de ba'ba tarungkun.

Tokke'mi ke'de' mesa malaeka'na Puang Allata'alla dio sa'dena Petrus pangngarrang illalan tarungkun. Untuyong-tuyongmi Petrus anna ma'kada nakua: “Sirra'ko millik.” Lappa' siami rante dio limanna Petrus.
Nakua pole omo inde malaeka'e: “Pa'beke'ko ammu pake palopakmu.” Ma'beke'mi Petrus anna ma'palopak. Nakua pole omo: “Pakei bayu rui'mu ammu ula'na'.”
Ummula'mi malaeka' Petrus suun illalan mai tarungkun, sapo tae' naissanan kumua dadi tongan inde pa'kuanna malaeka'e annu nasanga mangngimpi.

Ullewanni angngenanna to daga bunga'na anna kapenduanna, ullambi'mi ba'ba bassi untutu'i lalan lu tama tondok. Tokke'mi titungka' kalena napolalan naola Petrus sola malaeka' suun illalan mai tarungkun anna le'ba ummundu' lalan. Tappa umpa'deammi kalena inde malaeka'e.
Kilalai Petrus mane ma'kadari nakua: “Mane kuissanarri pole' temo kumua Puang Allata'alla ussua malaeka'na sae ullappasanna' dio mai kakuasaanna Herodes anna pa'kua penawanna to Yahudi.”
Mangkai ma'pikki' sappai' mengkalaomi lako banuanna Maria indona Yohanes. Inde Yohanes-e sidisangai duka' Markus. Buda tau ma'rempun dio ma'sambayang.
Undede'mi ba'ba bala Petrus, saemi mesa sabua' baine disanga Rode la umpetua'i.
Tappa ummissanan kamaranna Petrus, sapo ta'pa untungka'i ba'ba anna le'bamo kumondong tama banua natumang kadoresanna anna pokadai kumua sae Petrus.
Nakuamo to illalan banua: “Ta'mo tontong penawammu.” Sapo' nakua liu duka' tonganna sae Petrus. Nakuamo to illalan banua: “Malaeka'na muita.”
Menge liupi undedek ba'ba Petrus anna sasaeammo solana untungka'i. Mangnga-mangnga asammi ummita Petrus.

Ummangka'mi limanna Petrus umpakamma' solana anna mane tetteranni umba nakua suun illalan mai tarungkun natette Puang Allata'alla. Untampakkimi tula'na Petrus nakua, “Tetteranni kadadian iatee lako Yakobus sola lako angganna sa'do'doranta.” Mangkai mantula' mengkalaomi lako angngenan senga'.
Masiangngii, karambami tantara to daga dio pa'tarungkunan anna pusa' umpikki'i kumua battu aka dadi lako kalena Petrus.

Ussuami tau tomaraya Herodes umpeang Petrus sapo' ta'mo dengan nalambi'. Diparessa simesa-mesami inde to dagae anna mane pesuai Herodes dibaa lao dipatei. Mangkai too mengkalaomi Herodes dio Yudea lu lako Kaisarea anna torro dio.
Kamateanna Herodes

Attu iatoo keara' sigalimi tomaraya Herodes lako to Tirus anna to Sidon. Inde dua tondokke moika anna bassi tae' nakala' kaparentaanna tomaraya Herodes sapo' kammandeanna lu dio asan mai kaparentaanna Herodes. Napolalan ma'mesa anna ussua tau lao mengngolo lako tomaraya. Umpeangmi lalan inde to disuae anna usse'dek Blastus kapalana to mengkarang illalan banuanna tomaraya anna malara lao lako tomaraya anna pelauanni kenamala dengan kasikalinoan lako inde dua tondokke.
Inde anna lambi'mi allo pa'temponae umpakemi pakean tomarayanna Herodes anna ummokko' yao okkosan kamatandeanna anna mane mantula' lako tau kamban.
Marassanni mantula' tomaraya sipealo'-alosammi tau kamban umpakasallei nakua: “Itin kamarao, kamaranna dewata tangngia kamaranna ma'rupa tau.”
Tappa nalambi' siami perambinna Puang Allata'alla ummolai malaeka'na aka tae' umpakasalle Puang Allata'alla, iamo nangei masaki napolalan ollisan lambisan bonno'.
Barnabas anna Saulus dibassei bayu-bayu la umpalanda' Kareba Kadoresan
Budami tau urrangngi battakadanna Puang Allata'alla napolalan tuttuan kerangngan to mangngorean.
Mangkanna pengkaranganna dio Yerusalem, ma'pasulemi Barnabas sola Saulus lako Antiokhia anna ussolaan Yohanes battu' dikua Markus.

footnotes.text: Napikki' to Yahudi kumua simesa-mesa ma'rupa tau pantan dengan malaeka'na undagaii.
